mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sol_preparation_source_reference ( preparation_id, item_id, source_type_code, source_object_type, source_object_id, source_reference_key, required_result_policy_snapshot, normalized_result_code, source_fact_version, source_watermark, sync_status_code, last_success_result_code, last_success_fact_version, last_success_watermark, last_success_at, last_synced_at, last_sync_error_code, version, creator, create_time, updater, update_time, tenant_id ) VALUES ( #{row.preparationId}, #{row.itemId}, #{row.sourceTypeCode}, #{row.sourceObjectType}, #{row.sourceObjectId}, #{row.sourceReferenceKey}, #{row.requiredResultPolicySnapshot}, #{row.normalizedResultCode}, #{row.sourceFactVersion}, #{row.sourceWatermark}, #{row.syncStatusCode}, #{row.lastSuccessResultCode}, #{row.lastSuccessFactVersion}, #{row.lastSuccessWatermark}, #{row.lastSuccessAt}, #{row.lastSyncedAt}, #{row.lastSyncErrorCode}, #{row.version}, COALESCE(#{row.creator}, ''), COALESCE(#{row.createTime}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)), COALESCE(#{row.updater}, ''), COALESCE(#{row.updateTime}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)), #{row.tenantId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE sol_preparation_source_reference SET sync_status_code = #{update.syncStatusCode}, normalized_result_code = #{update.normalizedResultCode}, source_fact_version = #{update.sourceFactVersion}, source_watermark = #{update.sourceWatermark}, last_success_result_code = #{update.lastSuccessResultCode}, last_success_fact_version = #{update.lastSuccessFactVersion}, last_success_watermark = #{update.lastSuccessWatermark}, last_success_at = #{update.lastSuccessAt}, last_synced_at = #{update.lastSyncedAt}, last_sync_error_code = #{update.lastSyncErrorCode}, updater = #{update.updater}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{update.tenantId} AND preparation_id = #{update.preparationId} AND item_id = #{update.itemId} AND id = #{update.sourceReferenceId} AND version = #{update.expectedVersion}
